title: Olive and the Lost Charm
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.

pages.brief: Olive the owl wearing a small shiny charm on a thin string around her neck, standing by the garden gate.
The string breaking, the charm dropping away from Olive near the garden gate.
Olive the owl looking down at her neck with a shocked expression, the charm nowhere in sight.
Olive the owl walking back along the path to a large plant pot.
Olive the owl searching around the base of the plant pot, finding nothing.
Olive the owl walking further back along the path toward an old log.
Olive the owl checking the top and sides of the log, still no charm.
Olive the owl returning to the garden gate where the string first snapped.
The small shiny charm resting in the grass right at the base of the garden gate.
Olive the owl smiling with relief, picking the charm up out of the grass.
